name: jengo/inertia
description: Inertia.js server-side adapter for Jengo CodeIgniter 4 applications, enabling modern SPA frontend development.

facades.description: Inertia facade to control state sharing, SSR, versioning, and redirects.

methods.render: render(string $component, array $props = [], array $viewData = []): ResponseInterface (Render Inertia component)
methods.share: share(string|array $key, $value = null): void (Share data with all Inertia components)
methods.disableSsr: disableSsr(mixed $disable = true): void (Disable SSR rendering for test environments)

config.description: Inertia configuration defining root view, SSR, filter alias, and error page mappings.

properties.rootView: string blade/PHP view file name serving as the Inertia root (default: 'app')
properties.isSsrEnabled: bool whether server-side rendering is enabled
properties.filterAlias: string filter alias for Inertia middleware
properties.errorPages: array<int|string, string> mapping of HTTP status codes to Inertia error components
properties.pages: array<string|int, string> general Inertia page components mapping
properties.showDebugInDevelopment: bool whether to display CI4 HTML debug trace in development instead of Inertia error page

methods.resolveErrorPage: resolveErrorPage(int|string $statusCode): ?string (Resolves component name for a status code)

exceptions.description: Custom CodeIgniter 4 ExceptionHandler for Inertia apps. Renders matching Inertia components for both SPA requests and browser navigation, returning proper HTTP status codes.

methods.handle: handle(Throwable $exception, RequestInterface $request, ResponseInterface $response, int $statusCode, int $exitCode): void
methods.getHandledResponse: getHandledResponse(): ?ResponseInterface (Access the built HTTP response object)

middleware.description: CodeIgniter 4 Filter/Middleware that auto-shares validation errors and flash session data, handles CSRF Vary headers, and client version reloads.

installer.description: Interactive installer command ('php spark jengo:install inertia') that scaffolds Vue, React, or Svelte client assets, Vite plugins, base views, filters, and publishes Config/Exceptions.php.

testing.description: Exposes HTTP request testing wrappers (get, post, put, patch, delete) that return Jengo's custom TestResponse with fluent assertions.

methods.assertInertiaFlash: assertInertiaFlash(string $key, mixed $expected = null): self (Assert redirect flash data)
methods.assertInertiaFlashMissing: assertInertiaFlashMissing(string $key): self (Assert redirect flash data does not exist)

testing.description: Fluent Assert class passed to assertInertia callback to verify component, props, reloads, and deferred props.

methods.component: component(string $value, bool $shouldMatchExactly = true): self (Assert Inertia component name)
methods.has: has(string $key, mixed ...$args): self (Assert prop existence, array count, or nested scoping)
methods.where: where(string $key, mixed $expected): self (Assert prop equals expected value)
methods.missing: missing(string $key): self (Assert prop does not exist)
methods.count: count(string $key, int $expectedCount): self (Assert prop array count)
methods.etc: etc(): self (Ignore un-asserted properties in current scope)
methods.reloadExcept: reloadExcept(string|array $keys, callable $callback): self (Verify partial reload excluding keys)
methods.loadDeferredProps: loadDeferredProps(mixed $groupsOrCallback, ?callable $callback = null): self (Verify deferred props loading)
methods.hasFlash: hasFlash(string $key, mixed $expected = null): self (Assert rendered page session flash)
methods.missingFlash: missingFlash(string $key): self (Assert page flash does not exist)

usage.exceptions: In Config/Exceptions.php: public function handler(int $statusCode, Throwable $exception): ExceptionHandlerInterface { return new InertiaExceptionHandler($this); }
